currentColor cascade gap: RN does not propagate a View's colour to descendant Text the way the web `text-*` class tints lucide icons via `currentColor`. Reproduced with an `IconBoxTintContext` provider carrying the resolved tint plus a `useIconBoxTint()` hook (the explicit native-safe analog of `currentColor`) for native icon-glyph children; plain string/number children are auto-wrapped in a tinted AppText so the common single-glyph usage (web usages always pass one icon child) renders coloured out of the box.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements (the <div> became <View>), clsx/tailwind-merge, lucide-react, recharts, leaflet, or web @/components/ui imports in the native output — only react, react-native, and the native AppText.
